_readme: deployUnits: for each production deploy unit, the repo paths whose change makes a new publish of that unit worth doing. Keyed by the ledger environment tooling/ci/record-deployment.mjs writes the unit's Deployment under; the key "<app>-web" stands for every app in deploy-web.yml's matrix (subscriptiontracker-web, and each app after it).

Read by tooling/ci/plan-deploy.mjs before every publish: it diffs the unit's latest SUCCESSFUL Deployment against the target commit and publishes only when a changed path matches one of these globs (row O-DEPLOY-IS-NOT-ONE-GATED-LANE, limb 3).

Today the globs are COPIES: "<app>-web" of deploy-web.yml's on.push.paths, and the two Workers of deploy-workers.yml's dorny/paths-filter filters, character for character. tooling/ci/test/deploy-units.test.mjs fails the build when a copy and its workflow disagree in either direction. D2b points the workflows at this section and retires that test; D1-1 moves the section, globs unchanged, into tooling/ci/lane-map.json.

Glob shapes: `X/**` (a tree), `X/*.ext` or `X/*` (files directly in X), or a literal path. plan-deploy.mjs refuses any other shape rather than guessing, through globClaims in assert-deploy-triggers-deploy.mjs.
